# Guild

> Guild tests AI systems and the apps built around them, and writes down what we find. Two services: CERT-In AI audit readiness for teams in India, and a Launch Check for apps built with Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0 or Cursor. Guild is not a CERT-In empanelled auditor, and nothing here is an audit certificate or legal advice.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.guilds.work/): what Guild does and who it is for.
- [Guides and free tools](https://www.guilds.work/guides): index of every guide and free self-check on this site, grouped by topic. Descriptions come from each page's own metadata.
- [Launch Check](https://www.guilds.work/audit): a hand check of an AI-built app across payments, deployment and domains, performance and cost, and security and data access, then fixes.
- [Launch checklist](https://www.guilds.work/checklist): a free checklist to run before real users put real data into an AI-built app.
- [Launch self-check](https://www.guilds.work/launch-check): a free, in-browser 20-question self-assessment (payments, deployment, performance and cost, security) with a list of gaps, each linked to the matching checklist item. Not an audit.
- [CERT-In AI risk tier calculator](https://www.guilds.work/ai-risk-tier): a free, in-browser self-check that scores an AI system on the eight risk factors in the CERT-In guideline. Unofficial; not an audit.
- [Indic AI QA pilot](https://www.guilds.work/indic-ai-qa): a two-week pilot for teams shipping chatbots, voice agents or LLM features in Hindi, Gujarati or Hinglish. Native speakers check meaning errors, register and politeness, code-mixing, transliteration, refusals, policy hallucination and judge agreement. Not an audit.
- [CERT-In AI Security Auditing Guidelines, explained](https://www.guilds.work/guides/cert-in-ai-security-auditing-guidelines): who the guideline covers, the risk tiers and a preparation plan, with section numbers. Unofficial guide.
- [Does CERT-In require an AI audit?](https://www.guilds.work/guides/does-cert-in-require-an-ai-audit): short answer from the guideline PDF; it states no effective date and no penalty in v1.0.
- [How to check Supabase RLS on an app built with Lovable or Bolt](https://www.guilds.work/guides/check-supabase-rls-lovable-bolt): dashboard policy list and an anon-key test on your own project.
- [What is an AI risk tier under CERT-In?](https://www.guilds.work/guides/what-is-an-ai-risk-tier-cert-in): the 1 to 4 tier, the eight factors and where to score your own system.- [DPDP readiness check](https://www.guilds.work/dpdp-readiness): a free, in-browser self-check with 20 yes/no questions, each tied to a section of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, with a plain-English fix for each gap. Unofficial; not legal advice.
- [DPDP Rules 2025: what Indian startups must do](https://www.guilds.work/guides/dpdp-rules-what-startups-must-do): the Act and the Rules (G.S.R. 846(E)) in plain English, with Act section numbers. Phase dates are per the notified Rules; check the Gazette.

## Source

- Official CERT-In guideline (PDF): https://www.cert-in.org.in/PDF/AI_Security_Auditing_Guidelines.pdf
- Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (official PDF): https://www.meity.gov.in/static/uploads/2024/06/2bf1f0e9f04e6fb4f8fef35e82c42aa5.pdf
- Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 (MeitY page): https://www.meity.gov.in/documents/act-and-policies/digital-personal-data-protection-rules-2025
- Contact: abid@guilds.work
